record_title: Growing-category multinomial modes: Gaussian critical dimension and correction hierarchy
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Equiprobable multinomial cells, m=o(N), and modal local probabilities only. No global total-variation or Le Cam threshold is claimed. Sparse occupancy and unequal growing cell probabilities are not covered. Older lattice-expansion literature remains a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
